notes.title: Roadmap + 7th Anniversary Update
notes.content:
[h1][b]7 Years of Wrath of the Goliaths[/b][/h1][p]
It’s hard to believe it’s already been seven years. Over that time, I’ve dreamed up countless ideas for this game, and I’m grateful to say that many of them have become reality. Today isn’t just another update; it’s a celebration. A celebration of dinosaurs, and of the game itself.[/p][p]As we look ahead, I’m excited to share what’s coming in the next update. I hope you’ll look forward to it as much as I do.[/p][p]Thank you, hunters, for being part of this journey.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/e98a7f60de40e4fb8f48279e7c2b8471ff209e12.jpg"][/img][/p][p]With the major updates outlined, some minor updates include:[/p][list][*][p]Reworked Main Menu[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The Bones Shop to purchase licenses with bones[/p][/*][*][p]A new tutorial to get new hunters started! [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Also improved flyer AI, they will move with the terrain, avoiding impact with the ground and each other. [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]It may be good to mention that among the handful of previous updates. Its worth mentioning, I made the switch to Unreal Engine 5 from Unreal Engine 4. It required a significant re-code for the menu and hunt systems. I also experimented with the various features Unreal Engine 5 has to offer. Many of these features were gorgeous, but significantly impacted performance. Some time was taken to undo many of those changes (Rollback and versioning software, who heard of 'em!).[/p][p]Looking ahead, I want to shake it off and continue strong.  With that, here is a brief look at some of these updates, concept art, and more! [/p][p]-----------------------------------[/p][h2]Dimetrodon TLC: [/h2][p][/p][h3]NEW: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/7da9ddf03218d9361e9c3cd29023bd7cf5f9c042.png"][/img][/h3][h3]OLD:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/dde4d604988cf354e5a5e31d371fb8bdb9a5c95d.jpg"][/img][/h3][p]This TLC was done by a collaboration with Feilong and Manuelsaurus.

-----------------------------------[/p][h1]IK and Locomotion update:[/h1][h3]Stegosaurus: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/8e166aa8482c15be332628fab8fae689bb2838f7.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/3ea6e1bc9dcf20351ffe6a711b7b7f7b6e03248f.gif"][/img] [/h3][p]-----------------------------------[/p][h2]Ancient Valley: [/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/21f7cb6c05b196e37df9e7a39d2e7818a6851f10.jpg"][/img]A refreshing new look for the starting map. Featuring updated lighting and reworked atmosphere and clouds for improved performance.  [/p][p]----------------------------------- [/p][h2]Eurodalosaurus concept art:[/h2][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/4bfc69cb8828c51629e46f8cabd5e5d6f193f75e.png"][/img] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/3185327c12901e519e6587ca2ced91bbce3e8c3e.jpg"][/img] [/p][p]These two pieces are only shown within the game-manual. Which will be revised once we leave early access. [/p][p] ----------------------------------- [/p][p][/p][p]All for now, but I hope you look forward to these updates. A bit longer with some major surprises still in store.  [/p][p]As we celebrate this milestone, I want to take a moment to thank you, the players. What started as a silly passion-project turned game has grown into something far greater than I could have imagined. That’s entirely because of your support.[/p][p]Every bit of encouragement, every piece of feedback, and every hour you’ve spent playing has helped me stay true to this project and keep moving forward. There were times when development was tough, but knowing that people believed in this game gave me the strength to continue.[/p][p][/p][h3]From the bottom of my heart, thank you for being part of this journey.

To 7 years!

- Matthew

[/h3]

notes.title: Soft launch of version 2.0
notes.content:
Hey hunters!

Long time no see, a formal announcement is underway. I'm excited to share this update as I begin to update many aspects of the Wrath of the Goliaths store page and social media pages. For now, jump right in and experience the plethora of changes done. 


Many things happened, I'll try to keep it brief:

- Updated to Unreal Engine 5.3
- Updated AI, carnivores are the top hunters. They will be attracted to noise and will try to rush you. Herbivores are skittish and will dart away. 
- Perks are added, buffs and debuffs!
- Many new maps are added as well as many redone
- A couple new hunts were added such as Concavenator and Eurodalosaurus
- Weapons were reworked
- Trophy room has been redone
- Achievements implemented
- Unlockables implemeneted
- Brand new UI and Hunt menu


I'm looking forward to receiving feedback! 

Till next time hunters!

notes.title: 2nd Anniversary | Public Test Branch | What is to come!
notes.content:
[i]Things have taken a long time to get sorted out, and my heart goes out to those affected by the novel Covid-19. [/i]

The first anniversary was hardly acknowledged, but I was more prepared the second time around. Thank you for supporting Wrath of the Goliaths! Here's to the 2nd Anniversary! This update will bring the game closer to completion, minus a bit of content that is coming down the road. In celebration Wrath of the Goliaths will go on sale tomorrow at 25% off! 

Without further ado, let's take a look at the upcoming locations and the available hunts!

[h1]New huntable areas[/h1]

[h2][b]Overlook Peak[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/423d39cdbc438f3e5ea6f5f38d8015956d7bd2e9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/1fa1e514b7040b8b249ae7a08a721ffee47190c6.png[/img]

A forest featuring many new hunts! This area is a medium sized hunt area, boasting around 5 hunts! 

- T.Rex - Trophy Hunt

- Apatosaurus

- Triceratops

- Stegosaurus

- Pteranodon

And in case you download the upcoming Pentaceratops DLC, there will be two additional hunts.

- DLC - Pentaceratops

- DLC - Stokesosaurus


[h2][b]Cascade Wetlands[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/305a110e978a861c017eac25a1177e803a2cbdac.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/ce1d0ac880e7911c5f9b35019b60f7a5315b18ce.png[/img]

This is a medium sized hunt area, but be weary of the foliage. It's the perfect camouflage for many of the predators that roam the swamps.

Here's a handful of species you can hunt here:


- T.Rex - Trophy Hunt

- Dilophosaurus

- Prestosuchus

- Carnotaurus

- Triceratops

- Geosternbergia

And in case you download the upcoming Pentaceratops DLC, there will be one additional hunt.

- DLC - Stokesosaurus

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

There's been a lot of TLC done to some of our current hunts.

[h1]Here are some revamped dinosaurs[/h1]

[b][h2]Megalosaurus[/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/dad97669a4f61314a1273988b9772125eacc4b16.png[/img]

[b][h2]Triceratops[/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/629d9146288d4c860b9ad5df36728527cd8562ba.png[/img]

[b][h2]Stegosaurus[/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/fa9a3932e4eb455de4a985f37f80c6d727259e2a.png[/img]

[b][h2]Sauroposeidon[/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/44b127b0cb64fffa0a4120b2370982cd1357d6a0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/22784f97d7b2bfb6cb158fb8cbff6d56999a2781.png[/img]


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]Now let's take a look at some new hunts! [/h1]


[b][h2]Nigersaurus:[/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/ae2d45d0dd5ec4246237be66f05be3dabbbe8faf.png[/img]

This bizarre hunt love's to graze on grass. Since they were rediscovered, they have been incredibly fond of dryer vegetation. It mostly likes to be left alone, but will trample you if disturbed.

[b][h2]Brachiosaurus:[/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/4e16cca5ddb785c054fda04403471ddfaae3127c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/202033e92b83e34e5a5e75d970e3473eaa0fe068.png[/img]

A gentle giant, this is one of the first Goliath hunts available! Are you capable of taking on a Goliath Hunt?

[b][h2]Regaliceratops:[/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/48d6c51eb5b96d8f2ed88126bc93616cfe2f9bf8.png[/img]

This dinosaur is definitely is something to look at. If you come across a Regaliceratops, be sure to have a strong weapon. This dinosaur and along with the previous two make their debut on the Overlook Peaks map.


[b][h2]Styracosaurus:[/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/077de24794034abb8271ff0ccf507e11e990dc0f.png[/img]

The Styracosaurus is fairly aggressive with it's loud thundering feet. You will be able to tell when one is nearby. It doesn't need to be stealthy when it can easily impale you! Be weary hunter. This hunt will be available on both new maps.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]Now the new weapons!
[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/91bf28b41b2b0eebf715d2a32979ddcb08d0a9e0.png[/img]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/3c12b80c0f53aa9259c14f50ef73eef4c894b852.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/60e9c654d7f274e27ec390d384078d93e0ef3238.png[/img][/url] - The X-Sniper is a lethal weapon capable of taking out a goliath dinosaur with a single well-placed headshot, or a couple of body shots. This weapon is a must if you plan on bagging a goliath!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/4f8f054cc51f89e7002dba41ff0306ce0e1d6f8e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/fd56312dfca63dcad47280f33a1a071348ce79f3.png[/img][/url] - The Spitfire, perfect for quickly warding off ambushing dinosaurs. It will take care of any little dinosaur with ease.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/f4fd19a137912baacf85b1a588b9f538623a5397.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/3b106233ae75ae3905da38729110bb2851f2e3d7.png[/img][/url] - The Decimator is equipped with four barrels. A quick way to get in and out of each hunt, surely a hunters best friend, but at a big price!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/fe1a7dd14e0df71c9ba1b107aa1c17a429cbafb0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/72d7a4a4a7e5d65ddf4c0ca8eab938f4ef22065a.png[/img][/url] -The Triumvirate Rifle is a semi-automatic rifle. Quick for picking off any wandering dinosaur.


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Now where else would you store these new hunts once you've gone and bagged them? Well the trophy room of course!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/c2c2f3fd565e6f1a48327a6254f714cc3c24102e.png[/img]

Here you will build a vista of your own trophies you've gathered through hunting in free hunt. You will start out with very limited breathing room and as you get more trophies, you will naturally be able to work towards unlocking the rest of the vista!


If you happen to no longer want to keep your trophies you can sell them for a new in-game currency known as "Bones". Whatever happens to your old trophies, happens and is permanent so make sure you want to sell them. 

You will be able to use the new currency to purchase unlockables such as new hunt licenses, weapons, and more! As well as being able to use the currency to expand your trophy room. 


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Let's take a look at some of the updated maps:

[h2][b]Haystack Ridge at Dawn:[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/78b90fe0bab8daada9cd2528696597115643531a.png[/img]

[h2][b]Haystack Ridge at Noon:[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/d64f839beac111c01b771f1eec580db5d1a5fead.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/ac291f2a41a39a1253a7aa687a4a0796283f1864.png[/img]

[h2][b]Haystack Ridge at Night:[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/d82cc06bd51fdf0ce9ca295ba0209243a4e62915.png[/img]

Yes, time of day! You can check out Haystack Ridge and the Sonoran Desert hunt areas at different times of day. Other maps will eventually receive the same treatment, and in future updates there will also be time of day specific events such as certain hunts only coming out at night or day.

[h2][b]Flatlands:[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/e7fba67c69ddd1b06ba859613949d40ceacd5cdf.png[/img]

The Flatlands now has some trees! The Apatosaurus' are very happy about this change, it's even attracted Sauroposeidon! You may have a long way to go before you're able to take on this hunt.


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h3][b]Alternate Skins[/b][/h3]

There has been a bit of randomness involved in how the skins were selected. That's been changed to be more of an exact chance. I am also happy to say that most of the animals now have a melanistic and albino skin that is more in line with how these work in nature. 

Here is an example of the Albino and Melanistic variants of Stegosaurus, alongside the common variation:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/75d9fecf7494b0f0319e9c6736ef52525b993978.png[/img]


Here is a sneak peak at all the available skins for Megalosaurus:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/3dbc31ef4a843da28302573d6068a0620fa178d0.jpg[/img]



-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Here are some quality of life changes and some bug fixes (Some of which were talked about in previous posts):

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
- Fixed a bug with how the shotgun was firing
- Several redundant issues fixed that would cause drops in the framerate
- Weapons no longer fire after you die
- Ragdoll fixes and tweaks
- Grenade bounce issues
- Audio tweaks and changes such as replacing the foot step and landing audio
- Various other minor bug fixes
- Modified how the AI interacted with the environment. The AI will attempt to stay inside the play area, and if the AI is a carnivorous dinosaur it will attempt to kill you when shot. The dinosaurs will investigate any sounds made, and patrol the area for a bit before wandering off again if it doesnt see the player


[h3]Quality of Life changes:[/h3]
- Raytracing support
- Stegosaurus speed has been reduced, and is no longer capable of running
- Megalosaurus speed has been reduced

notes.title: Devlog - Summer Update Progress
notes.content:
Hey hunters! 

The summer update is coming along well, here's just a bit of what is to come:

- Trophy Room
- Reworked Trophy save system, revamped to allow 20 dinosaurs to be bagged as well as more info such as weapon that killed the dinosaur and the distance the kill was taken down
- New Map with more dinosaurs being brought back in
- Dinosaur kill animations
- Reworked AI

Status on implementation:

- Trophy Room is about 50% of the way done (The design of the room itself is about 10%), with the code for it being about 90% (Just some polish on how the room saves)

- Reworked save system is done

- New Map and dinosaurs is about 45% done, map needs to be fleshed out more, dinosaurs have the new materials apply and new animations will be worked on or tweaked

- Dinosaur kill animations are about 10% done

- Reworked AI has yet to begin. I will be re-examining how the AI is done and make it more fun to hunt dinosaurs and add a level of uniqueness to each dinosaur. I know that has been one of the biggest complaints, and it was next on the check list after fixing frame-rate issues. 

When I fixed the frame rate issues, I did remake the entire game from scratch for the most part to ensure I nailed the bug down. It was hell, and unfortunately it left the game more bare bones than at launch. So I worked toward making the game more fleshed out with content, I realize that was a double-edged sword as now the content lacked any personality. 

This took a personal toll on me, as I received loads of criticism, and I thought I had no healthy way to express that I was a solo developer and this was my first outing. 

Moving forward, I want to make sure the content in the game appeases both fans of the great Carnivores series and fans of hunting games and dinosaurs.

notes.title: News - 1/24/2018
notes.content:
[b]Upcoming plans[/b]

An update on the current patch. We are hard at work to make it include many additions and fixes. We have recently decided to re-do our AI in hopes it will fix one of the biggest issues with the frame rate. Currently, we are unsure of the exact cause, although we have found that it may be the AI or the foliage. We have planned to replace the foliage eventually, and as for the AI, I will be thorough and clean as I possibly can. 

We do use Blueprints to program the project, and C++ could help us fix a lot of major issues. So I will be taking some time to create AI that is C++ based or we will figure out an alternative.

What does this mean for the updates? Nothing too out of the ordinary, in fact! We will be adding a lot, from aquatic hunting, to several new areas to hunt. Time of day and weather effects are in the game as of now and some of the feature will be present in the upcoming update. 

[b] Progress so far![/b]

Matt has recently been hard at work and has now completed a majority of the audio for our 20+ animals in-game! And our newcomer, Jonathan has animated Apatosaurus and the new T.Rex model along with creating audio for the T.Rex. Jonathan also developed a new soundtrack for our main menu! I am incredibly excited to implement all of these, the Main Menu will also feature an update too! Charlie and Moreno have also worked hard on the weapons. Moreno is getting a ton of new explosives done and the last few weapons. Charlie and I will be working together soon to get the trailer done. Thus, we are quite literally on the verge of Early Access and I couldn't be more proud of my team! The UI is next on our list to update, however, we have much to implement before we go live; I will leave you all with this. 

[b] A Mysterious Hunt has been discovered![/b]

A theropod has been spotted, but only in unconfirmed reports from hunters in exclusive areas. This theropod appears to have been never documented before, appearing to have long arms with sickle like claws, and quill-like spines along it's tail. We are awaiting more reports on this creature.

notes.title: Update 0.1.1.0 is now live!
notes.content:
We apologize for the delay, we were able to add a lot more than originally planned because of it; but some parts are still missing. We will be adding those as they are made in hot fixes. The current update 0.1.1.0 has been difficult to work on, but has breathed new life into the project as we have now added unlockables! That means we have moved from a sandbox where you can hunt a T.Rex from the get go, to a more creative game that requires the player to find creative ways to unlock many features. We will soon implement the hunt gallery where you can find all the hunts you have chosen to keep, and a better hint system; in part to the new unlock system.

[b]New features:[/b]
- Updated First-person animations
- TR Shotgun, a power shotgun capable of hunting down even the largest of predators in only a few shots
- Valcon SMG, a quick way to deter any animal
- New crosshair
- Updated AI for Utah Raptor
- Updated AI for Dimetrodon
- Updated AI for Edaphosaurus & Compsognathus
- New unlockables! Hunt various dinosaurs to unlock more. Unlockables can be earned by hunting specific dinosaurs (Hints for these will be added in a later patch), or can be earned by gaining enough perma! 
- Controller keys and actions options
- Audio Control options
- Updated graphics options
- Added audio sensing to AI, try to hold your fire until you're capable of taking down your target
- Animation speeds updated
- Hunter run speed updated to 1,200
- Hunter walk speed updated to 500
- Hunter now can fire while running
- Weapons now apply a bit of a kickback, which raises the camera each time the weapon is fired:
TR Shotgun: 10 degrees
RP500: 5 degrees
Valcon SMG: 15 degrees
Pistol: 2 degrees
- Hunt calls have now been added, but temporarily disabled
- Herbivores now flee when frightened
- Herbivores now react with Carnivores, fleeing away when theyre near
- Carnivores now react with Herbivores, attacking their preferred diets
- In-Game UI overhauled
- UI configured to work with Steam (I.E. Main menu displays your correct Steam name and profile picture, displays your current friends and their online status, shows players who are in the same game/lobby)
- Added map images to multiplayer UI selection
- Fixed spawning in multiplayer
- Added Elasmosaurus, Parasaurlophus, Allosaurus, Carnotaurus, Majungasaurus and Carcharodontosaurus to Multiplayer

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
- Optimization
- Crosshair not fading when zooming in
- Better aligned animations for more accurate hunting
- Several AI bugs to be detailed later
- Slight changes to Multiplayer
- AI optimizations
- Ragdolls are now correctly implemented
- Hunt menu bugs (I.E. choices not carrying over, wrong map being ultimately chosen, prices being miscalculated)
- Fixed AI attack spheres

An audio update will come out soon that will add audio to each animal that has none or is missing any. We had to relieve Rolland as he had to move on and didn't have spare time for WOGD. We thankfully were able to have Matt come back on the team to help out for the time being. As such, this was one of the reasons for the large gap between the last update. The others being new techniques I learned, and revamping our old system for the animals. Which has helped us optimize the game better and allow it to run on more PC's. We want to thank you all for bearing with us, and we hope to see you at launch soon!

Please note that these may not be every change, more exact changes like AI values, and smaller fixes and updates are not noted. In future hot fixes and releases we will be able to note that

[i][b]REMINDER[/b][/i] This is the last update to contain multiplayer until further notice.
